{{Top|leg}}
'''Masrizeen''' was a chemical compound produced by [[kalaide]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cols/Legends|Cols]] to spur fertile periods in their reproductive cycle. The chemical could be used to create viable antidotes for the [[Jurrinex6]] and [[Jurr-5]] [[hive virus]]es.<ref name="CotG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
